values.note: 2026 rates: water-and-electric sites (1-4, 12) $46 a night, full-hookup pull-throughs (8-11, 13-14) $48, full-hookup back-ins (5-7) $56, each for up to 4 people; $5 per additional person 6 or older. Stay 7 nights, get one free. Tank pumping for non-sewer sites $15 flat.

fees.source: https://byrdsbranchcampground.com/rates/ ('2026 Rates: Water and Electric Sites: 1-4 and 12: $46.00 per night up to 4 people ... (Back-in Sites) 5-7: $56.00 ... (Pull-Thru Sites) 8-11 and 13-14: $48.00'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Online through the park's ResNexus page ('BOOK NOW'). The 2-night weekend minimum applies March-December; holiday weekends need 3 nights. One night's deposit at booking.
